narrative.overview: Morning Desk is a quiet daily briefing, read in a glance before the day starts. The weather and the home's power come first; everything else on the screen is secondary and stays out of their way. The page is dark and calm so it can sit on a screen all day and dim itself at night without glaring. The look is soft and friendly rather than technical: rounded panels, pill and round controls, and generous spacing, so the whole household is comfortable with it. Precision lives in the readouts, not in hard edges: large tabular numbers, small mono labels, and a solar diagram that reads like a lit night-blue instrument set into the page.
keyCharacteristics: Dark charcoal page with softly lifted, rounded panels.
One action colour (lime), used for primary actions, focus and live accents.
The solar diagram is its own night-blue world, with flow colours that mean something (green for solar and household load, cyan for the battery).
Readouts in large tabular numerals; labels in small uppercase mono.
Honest state: LIVE or OFFLINE in the header, and stale data is labelled as stale.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Lime means "act here" or "you are here" (primary button, focus, live readout). Don't use it for decoration.

rules.name: The Meaningful Flow Rule
rules.body: In the solar diagram, colour encodes the source: green for solar and household load, cyan for the battery, coral for the grid. Never recolour a path for looks.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text renders below 11px at any width, including the solar diagram on phones.

rules.name: The Steady Numbers Rule
rules.body: Numbers that refresh in place use tabular figures, so they never jitter.

rules.name: The Glow-Means-Live Rule
rules.body: A coloured glow appears only on something that is currently active (a live source node, the LIVE badge). Idle elements stay flat.
